{{Top|leg}}
A '''jevesect''' was a herbivore native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Herzob]] that resembled a giant [[Insect/Legends|insect]]. They were studied by the [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Burbu]].
